importantFindings.title: When a pasted row's age and date disagree, the row is stuck and the screen never says why. Correct sheet rows are blocked, and a date fix leaves a stale age that blocks again
importantFindings.scenario: The sheet prints 01/10/2010 and Età 16. The age was computed by year or at enrolment, and the camera path tolerates one year for exactly this reason. The answer 'Veldor;Marta;01/10/2010;16;' shows age 16 flagged. Controlla and focusing the age do not clear it. Save then refuses with 'Completa nome, cognome, età e sesso. Controlla la data di nascita se è presente.' Nothing says the date gives 15 at course start. The operator can only type 15 (not on the sheet), clear the correct date (then declared age 16 is stored, which is wrong, and the date is lost) or delete the student. The same happens after fixing a swapped date: the age derived from the wrong date (15) stays and blocks the row (probes offbyone O1, ui2 Q8).
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Show the conflict explicitly ('Sul foglio 16, dalla data 15 all'inizio del corso') with one-tap 'Usa l'età dalla data' or 'Correggi la data'. Recompute a derived age (no printed age, not typed) whenever the date changes. Now that the date is always visible, consider the camera's one-year tolerance, never across 18, for pasted rows.

importantFindings.title: Save does nothing, with no message, when only unread lines or the unacknowledged interrupted answer block it
importantFindings.scenario: The assistant forgets FINE. The last row moves to the unread lines. The operator re-reads that line and checks every row. The counters read '0 righe da controllare · N allievi pronti' and the counter button is disabled. Tapping 'Aggiungi N allievi' does nothing: no alert, no scroll, and focus stays on the button (probe Q2). With an unread line left, the save also refuses silently (Q2b). On a 30-row review the banner and lines are far above.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: When commit refuses for a paste reason, scroll to and focus the banner or the first unread line and announce why. Count the pending 'Ci sono tutti gli allievi' in 'righe da controllare', or show the reason beside a disabled save button.

importantFindings.title: A well-formed, complete answer that silently omits a student is saved without any prompt to count
importantFindings.location: src/features/students/StudentScan.tsx:1155-1159 (acknowledgement only when FINE is missing); src/capabilities/rosterPaste.ts:37-61
importantFindings.scenario: Assistants skip rows in long tables. An answer with 22 rows and FINE for a 23-row sheet passes: every row matches the sheet, Controlla ×22, save. The 23rd student is absent, and nothing on the screen invites a count. The 'Ci sono tutti gli allievi' question exists only for a missing FINE.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Require the explicit completeness confirmation for every pasted answer, showing the count ('Letti 22 allievi: il foglio ne ha 22?'). Also, or instead, ask the assistant to end with 'FINE <n>' and warn on a mismatch.

importantFindings.title: The V5-5 duplicate gate also changes the camera review, against 'camera path unchanged' and the F1 self-review's SC-18 'not changed'
importantFindings.scenario: Scan a sheet into a course that already holds Marta Veldor 2010-03-12. The scanned row now shows 'Possibile doppione' and save is refused until 'Tieni entrambi' or removal. That is a new blocking step in the camera flow.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Record the owner's approval (it resolves SC-18) and update the F1 self-review and next steps, or restrict the gate to pasted rows.

qolFindings.title: The empty-review text points to controls that are not there, and Back then drops the pasted answer without asking
qolFindings.scenario: The answer is only the header and FINE (the assistant read nothing), or every row of a complete answer was removed. The screen says 'Correggi le righe non lette qui sotto oppure torna alla risposta', but there are no lines and no 'Torna alla risposta' button. Back leaves immediately and the pasted text is gone (probe E). The discard heading can also read 'Scartare ?' (Q12).
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Always render 'Torna alla risposta' for a paste review. Tailor the message to what exists. Give the heading a fallback.

qolFindings.title: Placeholder-like names still become candidate students
qolFindings.scenario: 'N.N.;Marta;;12;', 'X;Y;;16;', 'Non leggibile;Marta;;16;' and 'Veldor;Illeggibile.;;16;' are all read as students (probe Q9, P16). Only the per-row Controlla holds them.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Strip punctuation before the placeholder lookup. Add 'nn', 'n.n.' and 'non leggibile'. Require at least two letters per name field.

qolFindings.title: A small header deviation rejects the whole answer with a generic message
qolFindings.scenario: 'Cognome;Nome;Data di nascita;Eta';Telefono' or the header with a trailing ';' gives formatMissing (P1, P2). The operator sees only 'non è nel formato richiesto', with no line and no reason. The parser's per-line reasons are discarded.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Name the expected header in the message, accept a trailing empty header field and the Eta' spelling, or show the lines the parser reported.

qolFindings.title: Clearing a wrong pasted date keeps an age derived from it; an age shifted into the phone column is silently dropped
qolFindings.scenario: Check 'Veldor;Marta;03/12/2010;;' and then clear the date. Age 15, computed from the rejected date, stays unflagged and is saved as declaredAgeAtCourseStart 15 (Q8b). 'Veldor;Marta;;;16' with the phone off loses the 16 without a hint (P4).
qolFindings.suggestedFix: When a date changes or is cleared and the age was derived from it, recompute or clear the age and flag it. Mention a non-empty telephone column when the phone was not requested.

qolFindings.title: The browser no-network proof ignores same-origin requests
qolFindings.scenario: The assertion filters out the app's own host. A regression that POSTs the pasted roster to the app's own origin would pass.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: From the paste onward, assert that there is no non-GET request and no request URL or body containing roster text.

qolFindings.title: V5-12 residual: no cap on answer size
qolFindings.scenario: A runaway or looping answer renders hundreds of cards. Round 1 measured about 8.5 s for 400 rows plus 400 unread lines.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Cap the number of lines, for example 150, with a visible message.

qolFindings.title: V05 closure evidence is missing and must come from the final tree
qolFindings.scenario: The component changed after every recorded run. No real assistant answer is in the corpus; the owner now checks this in UG1_DEVICE_VALIDATION.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Rerun v05-assistant-paste on the final tree, record verification with npm run evidence, and write domain-review.json from the final review.

roundOneFindingsVerified.note: Enter in an unread-line input is handled with preventDefault and runs Rileggi riga. commitCandidates also refuses while any unread line remains, so a missed keydown cannot save. Probes Q1 and Q1b: nothing saved; the line is resolved or kept.

The date is always rendered for a from-assistant row that has one, and stays mounted after Controlla (probe Q4 shows 2010-12-03). A disagreeing printed age is kept as a conflict and needs an exact match. The resolution UX is poor (V5R2-1).

Unread lines count in the rows to review, the counter jumps to them, and save is refused until each line is fixed or left out. A missing FINE needs 'Ci sono tutti gli allievi'. The refusal is silent (V5R2-2).
The guard is active with only unread lines, and the discard heading names them. Torna alla risposta, Back and another image all ask (component tests).

Duplicates within the batch and against the existing roster are flagged until 'Tieni entrambi' or removal, including a 4-field copy and case or spacing variants (Q5, Q6). The match needs an exact age, and the gate now applies to camera rows too (V5R2-4).

The prompt pins four ';' per row and 'non calcolarla'. Rows of 3–4 fields are accepted with per-column checks (shifted rows still fail), and Torna alla risposta restores the exact answer. Real assistant outputs are still not in evidence; the owner checks this at UG2.
The phone is neither validated nor stored when it is off, and the prompt says to leave it empty.
Partial: header words and Nota are rejected. 'N.N.', 'X', 'Non leggibile' and 'Illeggibile.' still pass (V5R2-6).
An out-of-range age survives Controlla and clears only by editing the age or focusing and leaving it (Q7).
Without FINE the last parsed row moves to the unread lines as 'forse troncata' (P7, P21).
Partial: a line fixed in place goes back to its sheet position (test). The paste empty message refers to controls that are absent (V5R2-5).
Partial: fences are matched strictly and interior spaces collapsed; there is still no size cap (V5R2-10).
